title: New ways to play
notes: Concert mini-game: on show nights, tap along to the big song. Good timing lifts the review.
Build your tour show act by act: effects like rain, fireworks or a flying platform, and costume changes.
Music videos: pick three shots and watch the cut.
Merch designer: design shirts, hoodies, posters, vinyl, totes and bracelet kits that sell every week, and more on tour.
Loop: an invented streaming app with trends, playlist pitches and its own chart (from 2012).
Create your own artist: a fully invented career from the first open mic.
Fixed: the stage designer now appears the first time you open the Tour Desk.
